import os, functools, http.server, socketserver
D = os.path.expanduser('~/.cache/notice-preview')
class H(http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):
    # vercel.json sets cleanUrls, so the deployed paths are /place and /type
    # with no extension. Without this the nav menus 404 in the preview and
    # only in the preview, which reads as a broken page rather than a
    # missing server feature.
    def translate_path(self, path):
        p = super().translate_path(path)
        if not os.path.exists(p) and not os.path.splitext(p)[1] and os.path.exists(p + '.html'):
            return p + '.html'
        return p
H = functools.partial(H, directory=D)
socketserver.TCPServer.allow_reuse_address = True
socketserver.TCPServer(('127.0.0.1', int(os.environ.get('PORT', '4173'))), H).serve_forever()
